coverage_check: League-wide screen of every TE with 30+ targets or PFF 68+ in 2025 or 2026 across all teams, including IR/reserve/free agents (no free-agent TE met the screen). Every PFF 2026 top-12 TE and every 2025 top-10 TE is in the contention set, is an external control, or is listed in excluded with a reason. PFF receiving/run-blocking/pass-blocking sub-grades are behind PFF+ and inline/slot/wide alignment splits are not in public data, so PFF overall grade plus PFF route/run-block/pass-block snap counts (block share) are used instead. Unmatched join: Chigoziem Okonkwo (PFF) = Chig Okonkwo (nflverse), no top-10 case.
contention_basis: Step 1 only per commissioner t45s371: 10 proposed top-10 contenders plus 5 first-outs (Kraft, Loveland, Mayer, Goedert, Pitts). Judgment, not formula. TE evidence: PFF overall grade, PFF route/run-block/pass-block snaps (block share), YPRR, TPRR, EPA per target, NGS separation, volume, availability. 2025 full season plus 2026 through Week 8.
